extracted.name: Cricket Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: Great chocolate chip cookies with an eco-friendly protein alternative with a lower environmental impact.
instruction_lines: Mix butter and sugars until smooth and fluffy; add vanilla and egg.
In another bowl, mix flour, cricket powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Scoop dough onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until edges are light and golden.
